chunks: Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd narrated from Hassan, from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'Be mindful of Allah in the manner which He deserves,' so he said, 'He is to be obeyed and never disobeyed, remembered and never forgotten, thanked and never shown ingratitude.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Imam say is the meaning of 'Haqq taqatihi' (right of His fearing)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the verse 'Be mindful of Allah in the manner which He deserves' by defining true God-consciousness as a holistic state where divine obedience is consistent, remembrance is persistent, and gratitude is unwavering. This interpretation, recorded in *Kitab al-Zuhd*, emphasizes that 'Haqq Taqatihi' (the right of His fearing) is realized through the seamless integration of these three spiritual pillars in the believer's daily conduct.
